summary.business_type: Client-side Discord asset micro-utility web app (bilingual EN/ES)
top_findings: Sitemap hreflang omits x-default (HTML has it)
verify-seo CI gate does not cover /assets/* pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: trailingSlash always + absolute site; canonicals consistent
robots.txt allows AI crawlers, blocks training crawlers, Sitemap directive present
Sitemap: 54 URLs, all 9 new EN tools + 14 ES tool pages, 64 hreflang alternates (32 en/32 es)
404/500 correctly excluded from sitemap and carry no canonical

findings.title: Sitemap hreflang omits x-default
findings.description: HTML head emits hreflang=x-default but the Astro sitemap writes only en/es alternates.

findings.title: /pfps/ uses meta-refresh redirect
findings.description: 821-byte client-redirect stub to /assets/pfps/ with no H1/OG/schema.
findings.recommendation: Use a Cloudflare Pages _redirects 301 and drop the stub.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals not measurable
findings.description: Site undeployed on this branch; no field data.
findings.recommendation: Re-run CrUX/PageSpeed after deploy, prioritizing image-heavy /assets/ pages.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: content_quality 94-95, filler 0, ai_pattern 0, info density 1.0 on all new tools
600+ words spec-accurate prose + FAQ per tool, cites exact Discord limits

findings.title: Repetition flag on all pages
findings.description: repetition_score ~36-38 from shared chrome + keyword usage; not thin/spun.
findings.recommendation: Optionally vary supporting phrasing; keep keyword targeting.

findings.title: Light E-E-A-T author/date signals
findings.description: No visible reviewer or verified-date on tool pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 0 duplicate titles, 0 duplicate descriptions across 56 pages
All indexable tool pages: single keyword H1, self-canonical, logical H2/H3
Dense hub-and-spoke internal linking with deliberately varied anchor text

findings.title: 6 /assets/* titles over 60 chars
findings.description: dark 66, gaming 67, pfps 71, icons-2d 64, aesthetic 61, cyberpunk 61.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to <=60 chars with primary keyword front-loaded.

findings.title: /pfps/ missing H1
findings.recommendation: 301 redirect or add a real H1.

findings.title: CI gate excludes /assets/*
findings.description: verify-seo indexablePages omits asset pages, so regressions slip.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: SoftwareApplication + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage on every tool, all valid JSON-LD
ES FAQ schema carries inLanguage es

findings.title: FAQPage rich results retired (May 2026)
findings.description: Markup still valid for AI/Bing; no FAQ rich snippet in Google.
findings.recommendation: Keep FAQPage; do not add HowTo.

findings.title: /about, /contact lack JSON-LD
findings.description: No entity schema on trust pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static Astro, minimal per-route JS; GA4 loaded with Consent Mode
Heavy client code (gifenc) scoped only to GIF tool routes

findings.title: No field CWV data
findings.recommendation: Measure post-deploy; confirm /assets/ gallery images set dimensions + lazy-load.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt present and kept in sync with all new tools
AI crawlers allowlisted; passage-level FAQ Q&A aids citability
Factual, spec-cited answers strong for AI Overviews/ChatGPT/Perplexity

findings.title: Light brand/Organization entity
findings.description: No Organization entity for AI attribution grounding.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema + consistent independent-brand statement.

findings.title: Formats/sizes not audited
findings.recommendation: Convert gallery thumbs to WebP/AVIF; confirm lazy-load.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add verified-date E-E-A-T line to tools

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run audit on live URL for CWV/CrUX + GSC indexation
Keep verify-seo green on every change
